title: Step III: Add the Lowest-Cost Edge

blocks.content: Step III: Add the Lowest-Cost Edge
The lowest cost edge is the one connecting A and F with a cost of 5. Let's add this edge to the minimum spanning tree.

blocks.alt: Choose the Edge With the Least Cost

blocks.content: Now, we move on to the edge with the second-lowest cost.
